title: Guard hardening residuals: installer config scope, hermetic tests, README pins, branch disposition

completion_criteria.text: Hook installation reads and writes its hook-path state in ONE config scope, so a global, system, or env-injected core.hooksPath is never recorded as the repository's prior value and never written back as local config. Proven by a test that is RED under hostile ambient config before the fix and green after.

The suite's result does not change when a global core.hooksPath or any GIT_CONFIG_* is present in the environment. Today 4 installer tests fail under that condition while the machine-local run is 622/622.

The ledger's own commit and merge path is unaffected by repository-local content filters and by repository-local signature-verification settings - OR both gaps are recorded as accepted in a decision and named in the README's accepted-gaps list.

The recovery store reports success only when the resulting store is usable, and never adopts a pre-existing unrelated repository at that path. A test covers a store directory that exists but is not a usable repo.
Every line-range citation in the README resolves to the code it claims, verified at the commit where it ships (six ranges are wrong at d102fb8; one lands on a deny while claiming ask).

The two inherited user calls are each recorded as a decision: commit attribution for the Round B `git add -A` sweep, and whether this branch is pushed and opened as one PR through the centralized pr-create tool.

spine.active_goal: Close the six residual criteria on fix/pre-tool-use-guard in DevLabs/continuity-ledger-plugin. User gave the go on 2026-07-28 for both inherited rulings: attribution accepted as-is (0072), branch pushed and opened as one PR through pr-create (0073).
spine.next_step: Two items remain. (1) Criterion 1 REOPENED by code review: legacy repos carry a poisoned local continuity.priorHooksPath and uninstall still writes it back as a local pin; migration fix in flight in hooks/lib/installer.mjs. (2) Criterion 3 needs the fourth README accepted-gap entry for .git/info/attributes per 0078, citing final git-env.mjs lines. Then the full suite under all three config environments, then push and open ONE PR through pr-create.
open_risks: Deliberate fail-closed trade at 07daf15: the installer nulls global and system config, so a user in a dubious-ownership repo who had a global safe.directory grant no longer gets hooks installed there. No compensating logic added.

GIT_ATTR_NOSYSTEM is undocumented in git 2.55.0's man pages though present and working. If removed, the system-attributes vector reopens silently, with no error and no test failure. A CI test for it is impractical, so 0078 is the only mitigation.

UNIMPLEMENTED, described only: continuity.priorHooksPath is written only in the !alreadyInstalled branch, so a repo already pointing at the managed dir with no recorded prior gets --unset on uninstall, not a restore. Safe fix writes '' (NOT current) only when the local key is absent.

Left open as outside 0028's model: hooks/dispatcher and hooks/commit-msg read continuity.priorHooksPath and continuity.trailer MERGED and the dispatcher execs the result; and a config value beginning with -- is parsed as an option at the write sites.

Latent, not live: RECOVERY_HEAD_REF is coupled by coincidence to DEFAULT_LEDGER_BRANCH. LocalDriver has no configurable branch today, so nothing breaks; the day it gains one, every pre-existing store is refused.
ALL VERIFICATION IS macOS, git 2.55.0, Node 26.4.0, ONE MACHINE. Unverified on Windows and older git. Note node --test <dir> is broken on Node 26.4.0; the glob form is required.
PROMPT FATIGUE remains the real failure mode and the prompt IS the protection. No test pins the newly-prompting command count.
Under a NON-DEFAULT ledger_branch the guard offers nothing (0036/0043). rm -rf .git && git init still destroys the ledger ref unprompted. Both documented, both deliberate.

Sandbox hooks/MCP question still UNVERIFIED per 0037: if MCP servers are subject to denyWrite, a denyWrite entry over the ledger root stops the plugin writing its own store. The test is a human action.
UNAUTHORIZED DEFECT, open, do not fix without explicit go: the Stop hook nags every turn (stop.mjs exits 2 unconditionally, never reads stop_hook_active). Surfaced five times with no user reply.
out_of_scope: Shell parsing, tokenization, allowlisting or head normalization in ANY form (0029/0054). Substring and quoting evasions are an accepted cost, not a defect.
A determined or adversarial same-uid agent, and the user's own deliberate deletion of their files (0028).
The other four canonical stores; future rollout, per-repo.
ledger-cli sync and publication of the _ledger ref. LocalDriver.sync() stays {synced:false}.
The continuity.trailer merged-read asymmetry in hooks/commit-msg - real, confirmed, but a separate atomic change.
